premium.basis: 92.4% premium over the February 24, 2015 closing price of $120.59, as stated in the SC 14D9. Also noted as 17.7% above the July 13, 2015 close and 44.6% above the June 9, 2015 close.

value_inflection_events.event: Party A unsolicited acquisition proposal and market outreach
Due diligence by Celgene and Party A; Celgene indicated willingness for contingent transaction
Phase 2 RADIANCE trial met primary endpoint in RMS
TOUCHSTONE Phase 2 trial met primary and secondary endpoints in ulcerative colitis
Media reports that the company was for sale and potential acquirors were considering bids
Media reports that several pharmaceutical companies were considering bids
Merger Agreement executed and tender offer announced at $232.00 per share

leaked_early.details: Media reports on April 1, 2015 and June 9-10, 2015 indicated the company was for sale and that multiple bidders were considering offers, more than one month before the July 14, 2015 announcement.

notes: The deal emerged from a 2013 unsolicited approach and two separate Celgene engagement periods, with a competing bidder (Party B) offering up to $225/share before withdrawing. The final $232/share all-cash offer represented a 92.4% premium to the unaffected February 2015 price, and the board opted against a broader market check citing prior media leaks that failed to attract new bidders.
